races.type: Federal Partisan Office • Vote for One
races.title: United States Representative, Rhode Island Congressional District 1
races.overview: Represents the voters of Providence, RI in the U.S. House of Representatives. Manages federal lawmaking, national budget appropriations, constituent advocacy, and federal agency oversight.

candidates.name: Gabe Amo
candidates.desc: Democratic candidate focusing on healthcare access, education funding, public infrastructure, and environmental policy for Providence, RI.

candidates.name: Allen Waters
candidates.desc: Republican candidate advocating for fiscal discipline, tax reduction, economic growth, public safety, and streamlined regulation in Rhode Island.

races.type: State Partisan Office • Vote for One
races.title: Rhode Island State Senate
races.overview: Represents local constituents in the Rhode Island State Senate. Authors state statutes, sets state tax policy, and votes on public education budgets.

candidates.name: State Senator (Providence, RI)
candidates.desc: Incumbent legislator prioritizing community economic development, infrastructure improvements, and healthcare access in Providence, RI.

races.type: State Partisan Office • Vote for One
races.title: Rhode Island House of Representatives
races.overview: Serves in the Rhode Island House of Representatives crafting state policies and constituent services for Providence, RI.

candidates.name: State Representative (Providence, RI)
candidates.desc: Focuses on local job creation, public safety, public school funding, and constituent advocacy.

races.title: Providence, RI County Executive / Prosecutor
races.overview: Oversees countywide criminal justice, public health, law enforcement, and regional services for Providence, RI.

candidates.name: County Candidate A
candidates.desc: Focuses on court efficiency, victim advocacy, public safety, and community diversion programs.

candidates.name: County Candidate B
candidates.desc: Focuses on administrative reforms, fiscal oversight, and law enforcement support.
